Adapted to DSH Desktop. | DSH 社区插件支持包：一个 skill + 两个审计工具（离线审计已装插件、安装前审计 tarball）","id":"gh:1335072703","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-community-plugins","slug":"HubaKing/dsh-community-plugins","topics":["agent-skills","ai-agents","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin-marketplace","skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin pack: one skill + two audit tools. dsh_plugin_audit offline-checks ins"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"talled plugins against this machine's dsh build; dsh_plugin_inspect judges a tarball before install."},{"id":"p1s3","text":" Adapted to DSH Desktop. | DSH 社区插件支持包：一个 skill + 两个审计工具（离线审计已装插件、安装前审计 tarball）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-community-plugins"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that teaches agents how to discover, evaluate and install **commun"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ity plugins** — and gives them two tools to check those plugins against the dsh build actually runni"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ng on this machine: one that stays offline, and one that fetches a package *before* it is installed."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**English** · **中文**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness provides plugin capabilities through two complementary mechanisms: **Tools** and **"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Harness provides plugin capabilities through two complementary mechanisms: **Tools** and **Skills**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | Tool (e.g. `market_search`) | Skill (registered by this plugin) |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Nature | Capability channel: callable functions | Context knowledge: when, why, and how to call |
"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"| Effect alone | Tool exists, but the agent does not recognize it | No marketplace interface to call"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"Effect alone | Tool exists, but the agent does not recognize it | No marketplace interface to call |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A marketplace tool alone is not enough, because agent behavior is driven by context knowledge. `web_"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"search` has an intuitive description and is any model's default approach; `market_search` is DSH-spe"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"cific. Without this skill the agent does not know it exists, does not associate it with installing p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"lugins, and does not understand the local profile layout, the bundle mechanism, the vetting workflow"},{"id":"p9s5","text":", or the restart requirement."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"And knowledge alone is not enough either: the ecosystem's one hard practical question — *"will upgra"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ding dsh break what I have installed?"* — cannot be answered reliably by hand, because the rc-prerel"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ease rule below defeats eyeballing."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why a live probe instead of a compatibility dataset"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Upstream declares the API surface unstable on purpose:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `README.md` — **"THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES."**
- `AGENTS.md` — **"Public APIs a"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"re pre-stable; update every consumer."**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A cached snapshot of that API surface therefore starts decaying the moment it is written. Measured h"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ere: **16 `0.x` prereleases in one month** — roughly one breaking change a week. A dataset would nee"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"d continuous maintenance and would be wrong between updates, and a verification tool that is confide"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ntly wrong is worse than no tool at all."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"So this plugin stores nothing. `dsh_plugin_audit` reads the dsh install root and the profile on ever"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"y call and answers for *this machine, right now*; `dsh_plugin_inspect` reads the tarball it just dow"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"nloaded and answers against that same build. No telemetry, no cache, no data to keep fresh — and whe"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"n something genuinely cannot be checked, both say `unknown` and give the reason instead of guessing."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"This is the difference from the ~75 marketplace plugins, the 3+ static auditors already in the ecosy"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"stem, and even the official runtime inspector: those list, rank, scan for *security*, or describe wh"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"at is live right now. None compare a plugin's **declared ranges and actual API usage** against **you"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"r** dsh build, and none can do it for a plugin that is not installed yet."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Complementary to the official runtime inspector.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis` ships `cordis_in"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"spect_*`, which queries the live runtime exactly (`Service.listService`, `Event.listEvents`, `Tool.l"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"istTools`, and `Slots.listSubTree` for real client-side slot props). For "what does the runtime look"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" like right now", that is strictly the better tool. This plugin answers a different question — "do t"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"he declarations on disk still line up with the build installed here" — and it still works where the "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"inspector cannot: **a plugin that failed to load is not in the live runtime, so the inspector cannot"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" see it at all.** Static inspection reads the disk; the inspector reads the process. Both are needed"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"see it at all.** Static inspection reads the disk; the inspector reads the process. Both are needed."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### The output contract, and why it is enforced in code"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A tool's return value must be **lossless JSON**: every reachable value has to survive `JSON.parse(JS"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ON.stringify(x))` unchanged. One `undefined`-valued property violates that, and the host's response "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"is to discard the *entire* result — the tool ran, downloaded, unpacked, judged, and delivered nothin"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" to discard the *entire* result — the tool ran, downloaded, unpacked, judged, and delivered nothing."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"That happened twice, from the same class of defect in two places: the github resolver had no `latest"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"Version`/`ageMinutes`/`skippedByAge`, which were merged onto the report unconditionally; and the liv"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e service probe could answer `undefined`, which was stored straight onto `runtimeServices[].present`"},{"id":"p21s4","text":". Registry specs were unaffected in the first case, so the failure only appeared on the path that ne"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"eded a GitHub release."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Both are fixed at the source, and the contract is now enforced rather than trusted: `lib/serialize.j"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s` sanitizes every report on its way out of **both** tools, and a repaired report says so at the bot"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"tom instead of being silently corrected. `isLosslessJSON()` ships in the same module — it is the che"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ck that would have caught the first occurrence, so it belongs in the code and not only in a test."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Symbol-level checking, and why "the package still exists" is not enough"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A plugin that does `import { PiAiAdapter } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'` keeps working only while tha"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"t package still *exports* `PiAiAdapter`. A rename or a split leaves the package in place and the bin"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ding gone — and an ESM named import of a binding the module does not provide is a **link-time throw*"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"*, not a degraded feature."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Confirming that is harder than grepping one file, because a package's export surface is a graph. Off"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"icial declarations are barrels, and TypeScript emits the source extension:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"A single-file scan reports every re-exported symbol as missing. So the check walks the graph — relat"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ive specifiers, the `.ts`/`.js` → `.d.ts` mapping, bare specifiers into other packages — and keeps t"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"wo things strictly apart:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- the set of symbols it **confirmed**, and
- whether that set is **complete**."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
